title: Method A Section 4.3 Job-2_UEL Phase-Field Fracture Simulation on F1703 Native Adapted Mesh: HPC Cluster Staging, Qualification, and Overnight Execution
scientific_objective: Execute genuine forward Job-2_UEL phase-field fracture simulation on the 10,065-element adapted mesh (PK_SEC43_JOB2_ADAPTED_PROD.inp, 30,195 layered elements, 30,289 DOFs) reproducing Pandey & Kumar (2025) Section 4.3 proposed PFM fracture progression (Figure 16b). Stage all dependencies to remote cluster (/scratch9/pr21vyci/runs/mode1_pk_sec43_job2_adapted_f1708), verify frozen production UEL f42_mixed_uel.for (CE8D5EDCD2911DCB018BB15275271F874E7EA62B8FB48CF4A8297469A83ACDD6, 907 lines), integrate dual-channel notification wrappers (email + Telegram), configure PBS directives (Job M1_PK_SEC43_JOB2_ADAPTED, 1 CPU serial reference anchor, 16 GB, queue normal_imfdfkmq, walltime 12h overnight per user policy), execute on HPC under once-only accounting, and capture authentic ODB for Figure 16b phase-field contour comparison.
